lines.arrive: A clinic. Very clean, very quiet, and very expensive.
lines.pitch: Plug in, and you can have any life you like. Write the great novel. Fall in love. Climb the mountain. Be adored. All of it will feel completely real.
lines.forever: Once you're in, you won't know it's a machine. Not ever. Not for the rest of your life.
lines.tanks: People, floating, smiling a little. Somewhere, they're having the best day of their lives.
lines.brochure: A brochure. Every picture in it is of someone laughing.
lines.demo: For a minute, you're on a stage, and everyone is cheering. It feels completely real.
lines.demo_2: And then you're back. It was wonderful. It was also nothing at all.
lines.plug_1: It's perfect. Everything you ever wanted, just the way you wanted it.
lines.plug_2: And you'll never know it isn't real. Does it matter, if you never know?
lines.idle: You don't decide. The technician shows you out, into the rain.
lines.home_1: Outside, it's raining. Your friend is waiting at the bus stop, and waves.
lines.home_2: Nothing out here was made for you. But it's real, and you're really in it. Is that worth more than feeling good?
